description: For the relation \(E(i,j)\leftrightarrow j=i+1\) on the natural numbers, a walk of length \(n\) from \(a\) to \(b\) exists exactly when \(b=a+n\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.directed_walk (n a b : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExpressiveLimits.Walk (fun i j => j = i + 1) n a b ↔ b = a + n
